provider_authority_lookup.credential_boundary: lookup URL must use the same scheme and host as its execution or compensation provider because it reuses that provider bearer token
provider_authority_lookup.recovery_rule: only a receipt_found response echoing the complete matching request identity, provider identity and a valid durable receipt may recover a lost response; pending absent unknown and lookup errors remain partial with unknown effect

invariants: dashboard actions create traceable task aggregates
task and minimum audit commit atomically
HTTP 2xx from an executor is not final success without a durable provider receipt
completed requires effect_state=confirmed and one or more stable effect_ids
transport ambiguity is recorded as partial with effect_state=unknown and is never rewritten as success or definitive failure
a lost response may be recovered only by an authoritative lookup of the exact provider idempotency identity and a validated durable receipt
provider lookup absence does not prove that no external effect occurred
authority lookup outcome is committed with task history and audit in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the terminal receipt
a permanent poison event advances its source offset only after the canonical DLQ record is broker acknowledged and the source tuple is atomically materialized with an audit receipt in PostgreSQL
compensation is accepted only against a matching optimistic revision and an original confirmed provider receipt
compensated requires a new durable provider receipt with confirmed stable effect identities
compensator transport ambiguity is recorded as compensation_partial with effect_state=unknown
domain.compensation: stop new work, preserve in-flight receipts, compensate only provider-confirmed effects and append immutable history audit outbox inbox and provider receipt facts

data.event_delivery: at-least-once with idempotent PostgreSQL inbox; permanent poison events require canonical dlq.v1 broker acknowledgement followed by an idempotent PostgreSQL source-tuple and audit barrier before source offset commit
